claims.text: The initial material is as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Introducing boron or carbon into as-cast HfMoTaTiZr will form boride or carbide precipitates.
Boride or carbide precipitates will produce precipitation hardening in HfMoTaTiZr.
Boride or carbide particles will toughen HfMoTaTiZr.
Formation of boride or carbide particles will decrease the overall alloy density.
Boron- or carbon-modified HfMoTaTiZr will have lower density than as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Boron- or carbon-modified HfMoTaTiZr will maintain the baseline yield strength at room temperature.
Boron- or carbon-modified HfMoTaTiZr will maintain the baseline yield strength at 1000 °C.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a density of 10.21 g cm−3.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a room-temperature yield strength of 1600 MPa.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has an elevated-temperature yield strength of 855 MPa.
The proposed operating boundary extends from room temperature to 1600 °C under yield-strength loading.
The controlled experiment compares as-cast HfMoTaTiZr with boron- or carbon-modified HfMoTaTiZr at room temperature and 1000 °C.
A density reduction of less than 5% falsifies the hypothesis.
A yield-strength reduction of more than 10% at either room temperature or 1000 °C falsifies the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis specifies performance over room temperature to 1600 °C, but the falsification experiment tests only room temperature and 1000 °C, so it cannot decisively evaluate the stated upper-temperature boundary.
